inj.note: The Steelers' left guard went down toward the end of the first half and was immediately placed in an air cast and carted off the field, suggesting this is a long-term injury for the third-year lineman. Spencer Anderson will handle left-guard duties for Pittsburgh the remainder of Sunday night's game.

news.h: Steelers OL Mason McCormick carted off field with air cast on ankle
news.d: Steelers guard Mason McCormick had an air cast placed on his ankle and was carted off the field with what appeared to be a serious injury Sunday night against the Bengals.
